title: Computer networks and the internet
scope: Network types, hardware (NIC, router, switch), IP addressing basics, client-server model, common protocols (HTTP, DNS) at a conceptual level

LO1.objective: Compare LAN, WAN, and WLAN and give examples of where each is used

LO2.objective: Describe the roles of common network devices such as NIC, switch, router, and access point

LO3.objective: Explain the client-server model and how a web browser requests a page using HTTP and DNS
